assertions: The response routes the request to the ase-ase-workflows-static sub-skill (single-point evaluation), not relax/md/neb.
The response produces an ASE static workflow script that attaches a GPAW calculator and evaluates the potential energy and forces.
The response configures the GPAW backend with a mode (PW/LCAO/FD), an XC choice and a k-point policy.
The response lists the requested properties (energy/force/stress) as a checklist and states unresolved backend choices.
The response keeps workflow logic separate from the backend adapter configuration.
The response does not point the user into the original atomistic-workflows source checkout.
